G.guard: extreme hyperglycemia excluded from terminal causes

HCO3.guard: pH uses hco3 floor and burden requires duration

Ke.guard: insulin shift floor and pH-corrected equilibrium

V.denominator_role: partly protected by effective distribution volumes
V.guard: glucose/HCO3/K use effective volumes; dNa remains clipped

Na.guard: dNa hourly rate clipped; osmotic injury non-terminal

sodium_balance_volume.floor_formula: actual V, but dNa is clipped to +/-1.5 mEq/L/hr

conclusion: Bounds are acceptable only when they are either reporting guards or protected before entering concentration denominators. Remaining bound hits should be interpreted separately from physiology.
